name: part
description: A part of a vector layer: one path with its own fill and stroke. Its coordinates are the layer's. Parts draw in their order in the layer: the last one on top.
help: A shape of a vector layer, with its fill and stroke.

visible.description: If false, the part is not drawn.
visible.help: When off, the part is not drawn.

fill.description: Fill color. null = no fill (only the stroke).

fillOpacity.description: How opaque the fill is, from 0 (invisible) to 1. Only the fill: the stroke has strokeOpacity.

strokeOpacity.description: How opaque the stroke is, from 0 (invisible) to 1. Only the stroke: the fill has fillOpacity.

strokeCap.description: How the stroke ends at the open ends of a line, and where a hidden edge opens it: round (a half circle past the end), square (a half square past the end) or butt (cut at the end).
strokeCap.help: How the stroke ends: round, square or butt.

strokeJoin.description: How the stroke turns at a corner: round, miter (a sharp point) or bevel (the point cut off).
strokeJoin.help: How the stroke turns at corners: round, miter or bevel.

originX.description: X of the origin: the point the part rotates and scales around, in the layer's coordinates. null = the center of its box. It moves along when the part moves.
originX.help: Origin X: the point it rotates and scales around. Empty = its center.

originY.description: Y of the origin: the point the part rotates and scales around, in the layer's coordinates. null = the center of its box. It moves along when the part moves.
originY.help: Origin Y: the point it rotates and scales around. Empty = its center.
